purpose: Teach: 東南アジア/四国/採取/タンパク質/探査/単身/誤差/交易

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、東南アジア、絶対、進出、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need this company to expand into Southeast Asia—seriously, absolutely. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Each clause lands with weight. The repeated emphasis sits heavy in the chest, not rushed. Unmistakable authority, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、四国、絶対、支店、絶対、開設、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're currently exploring a Shikoku branch opening in earnest. Thank you for your confidence in us.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. Clear enunciation on the key action points. Slight formal register lift—the voice of someone reporting up. Assured without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様データの、本気で、絶対、採取、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need rigorous customer data collection. No shortcuts. Make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Emphasis on thorough execution. Brief and final—not a conversation starter. The tone of someone who doesn't repeat himself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、健康食品、絶対、タンパク質、絶対、強化、絶対、製品、絶対、展開しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively developing a protein-enhanced product line for the health food market. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Measured report-back. Professional rhythm—confident but measured. The voice of someone ticking off progress toward a larger goal. Gratitude is genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、海洋資源、絶対、探査、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want this company pursuing marine resource exploration. Full effort. Make it a priority.
lines.style: Forceful but not angry. The word 'priority' carries the weight. Steady pace, no room for negotiation. Authority tempered by clarity of vision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、単身、絶対、赴任、絶対、社員、絶対、住宅手当、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're putting housing support in place for staff relocated on single assignment. Thank you for your direction.
lines.style: Composed acknowledgment. Each point stated as prepared fact. Professional distance maintained throughout. The voice of someone demonstrating readiness and care simultaneously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販売予測の、本気で、絶対、誤差、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch the sales forecast margins closely. Scrutinize every variance. I need precision.
lines.style: Sharp focus. Slight elevation on 'precision'—this matters more than the others. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone who knows where hidden problems live.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、国際、絶対、交易、絶対、ライセンス、絶対、申請しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively processing international trade license applications. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Final summary statement. Calm, complete. Slightly slowed pace on the last phrase—bringing closure to the meeting. Respect underscored by competence.
